tools.name: finish_fix
tools.description: Finish. Call exactly once, last, after the tests have run on your edits.

outcome.description: fixed when the findings are answered in code; refused when none can be.

subject.description: fixed: one line for the commit, imperative, under 60 characters, no prefix, no issue numbers, no trailers.

summary.description: Markdown for the PR comment: per finding, what changed, where, and why it answers it. Plain sentences.

tests_run.description: The test command you ran last and its result.

reason.description: refused: why no finding can be fixed in this PR.

tools.name: fix_list
tools.description: List a directory of the checkout (directories end with /).

path.description: Directory relative to the repo root; default the root.

tools.name: fix_read
tools.description: Read numbered lines of a file in the checkout. At most 400 lines per call.

tools.name: fix_run
tools.description: Run one allowed command in the checkout, without a shell; stdout and stderr together, capped. Default timeout 600s, at most 900s. The allowed commands are listed in the brief.

tools.name: fix_search
tools.description: Search the checkout with a JavaScript regular expression. At most 80 matches.

path.description: Directory or file to search; default the root.

tools.name: fix_write
tools.description: Write a whole file in the checkout (created if absent). Read it first and write it back complete. Never under .github/, .git/ or node_modules/.
